pred_texts: Instruct: Get a large pan and put it on the stove.
Instruct: Add about two tablespoons of oil and switch on the stove.
Instruct: Now get a chopping board, knife and an onion.
Instruct: Now, peel the onion and dice it.
Instruct: Now, carefully add the onion to the pan.
Instruct: Now, grab two tomatoes and dice them up.
Instruct: Now, add the tomatoes to the pan.
Instruct: Now, stir and fix the ingredients in the pan well.
